messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (12.3% over 5m). Pager triggered for eng-oncall. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/3161616161
eng-oncall: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and traces now.
ml-runtime: seeing repeat segfaults from model-runner (runner-3) after the last quant rollout ~T-30m. stack: 
```
  *** SIGSEGV (fault addr: 0x7ffdf123) ***
  backtrace: model_runner::kv_cache::read+0x2a
```
prod-support: multiple customers reporting 502s / timeouts, CS tickets: CS-1289, CS-1290. One enterprise tenant saw ~40% error increase.
eng-oncall: can we isolate to a model variant? ml-runtime: yes — the quant-q4a variant rolled last deploy; fallback to fp16 is possible. Also seeing OOM edges on encoders when batch_size>8.
sre-jim: temporarily reducing concurrency on gateway for that route to reduce pressure. Running: `kubectl patch svc/gateway -p '{"spec": {"externalTrafficPolicy": "Cluster"}}'` (will reduce some burstiness).
eng-oncall: start divert plan: 1) route new traffic to fp16-v2, 2) scale up fp16-v2 by +4 pods, 3) cordon runner-3, 4) rolling restart of quant runners.
ml-runtime: executing step 1. `trafficctl route set /v1/generate --variant fp16-v2 --weight 80` (starting slow ramp).
ml-runtime: logs from runner-3 show repeated KV cache corruption after ~120s of a request with long context. Proposing to disable prefix caching for quant variant as emergency patch.
alice: any quick mitigation that doesn't require deploy? maybe lowering max_input_len at gateway?
sre-jim: set gateway param `max_tokens_per_request` to 1024 for the route to limit worst-case memory blowups. Doing now.
prod-support: noting customers affected: AcmeCorp (high), Cloudify (medium). We should notify them with ETA and workaround. I'll draft a message.
eng-oncall: rolling restart completed for quant runners in us-west-2. Monitoring 5m window.
ml-runtime: after restart, one of the runners showed immediate segfault again — likely a binary/kernel interaction on that instance (driver reports GPU page faults). Marking node for eviction.
sre-jim: evicting node: `kubectl drain node/gpu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` and scheduling onto new node.
eng-oncall: traffic to quant variant back down to 0% while we stabilize. Current 5xx rate down to 3.2% (was 12.3%). Latencies improved.
prod-support: sent status update to AcmeCorp/Cloudify: "we're routing you to fallback model and limiting long-context requests; investigating root cause; PM ETA 2h".
ml-runtime: root cause hypothesis: quantized attention kernels regress under long KV cache use leading to GPU driver fault -> process crash -> 502. Mitigations: revert quant rollout, disable KVCACHE prefixing for quant, lower batch size and max tokens.
eng-oncall: agree. Preparing a rollback of quant-q4a to previous stable image. Will coordinate with releases.
sre-jim: will keep node drains rolling and watch for further GPU page faults. Recovery plan in place.
alice: adding short-lived alert for any GPU pagefault spike >1/min so we get earlier visibility.
eng-oncall: handing over to oncall for a 4h watch after rollback. Postmortem owner assigned: ml-runtime.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ACKNOWLEDGED: status -> mitigated (partial). Next update expected in 30m. :white_check_mark:
